Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

wdauto 0.2.0

Bug fixes

  • The login startup entry is now a UTF-16 VBScript file, so paths with Chinese or other non-ASCII characters (for example in the Windows user name) work. It also runs without a console window. Earlier .bat entries are replaced.
  • A cached driver from the same browser milestone is reused, so starting the service no longer needs network access when Chrome has no exact-build ChromeDriver.
  • reset_cs() warns instead of failing when the process record is damaged or cannot be verified, and still removes the startup entry.
  • Only the newest driver versions and service logs are kept, and only the chosen cached driver is executed for verification.
  • Tool failures report their output or timeout instead of an empty message.
  • Edge WebDriver listens only on the loopback interface.

New features

  • options(wdauto.mirror = "npmmirror") or custom URL prefix rules try a mirror before the official download servers.
  • get_cd(zip = ) and get_ss(jar = ) install manually downloaded files.
  • ChromeDriver is downloaded directly for the exact Chrome version before the Chrome for Testing metadata is used.
  • Selenium Server falls back to GitHub Releases.
  • auto_cs(backend = "chromedriver") serves Chrome through ChromeDriver at 127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub without Java or Selenium.
  • auto_cs(restart = "if_idle") restarts an idle service after a browser update instead of failing.
  • The login launcher retries for about two minutes and rotates its log.
  • get_cd() and get_ss() return the installed path invisibly.

Earlier changes since 0.1.1

  • Support Microsoft Edge with a dedicated WebDriver service and login startup entry.

  • Scope Selenium process and login startup cleanup to wdauto-managed resources.

  • Match ChromeDriver to the installed Chrome build and validate cached binaries.

  • Verify Selenium readiness, report startup logs, and refresh the login launcher.

  • Use Selenium 3.141.59 as the stable default for the existing pptsdd connection.
